test_title: PYST 15: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

Majority of the people give importance to **__transient__** things.
solution: The correct answer is **"Permanent."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Transient"** means lasting or continuing for a short period of time. (कुछ अवधि तक जारी रहनेवाला; क्षणिक, क्षणभंगुर, अस्थायी) • **Example**:* A glass of whisky has only a **transient**__ warming effect.* • The antonym of** "transient" **is **"permanent."** • **"Permanent"** means lasting for a long time or forever; that will not change. (देर तक या सदा के लिए रहने वाला, स्‍थायी; अपरिवर्तित, जो न बदले) __ • **Example**: *She has a **permanent**__ job.* • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • "Temporary" means lasting for a short time; not permanent. (अल्‍पकालिक, अस्‍थायी) • **"Monetary" **means connected with money. (वित्त-संबंधी, वित्तीय) • **"Material"** relates to connected with real or physical things rather than the spirit or emotions. (भौतिक (न कि आध्‍यात्मिक या भावनात्‍मक)) 46:Tbb1, The correct answer is **"Formidable**."
